interpretation.main_result: The former SOURCE_CONTEXT_PARAMETER bucket is structurally heterogeneous: experimental protocol/context, World-relative context, finite-run prehistory, intrinsic-system candidates, parameters, and underdetermined cases must be kept separate.
interpretation.C_guardrail: None of these placements upgrades a node to C. Existing frozen C mappings remain authoritative.
interpretation.World_guardrail: WORLD_CONTEXT means architecture placement relative to the modeled system boundary; it does not reconstruct an internal World ontology from the source claim.
interpretation.experiment_guardrail: EXPERIMENT_CONTEXT describes protocol/task/design placement, not a cognitive-system role.
interpretation.run_cut_guardrail: RUN_BOUNDARY_OR_PREHISTORY explicitly records that an experiment-relative start may inherit structure from earlier system–World history.
